//: Copy to server/sandbox.config.json (or set CCSERVER_SANDBOX_CONFIG) to customize the sandbox.
//docker: true (default): start an isolated rootless dockerd inside the sandbox. false: no docker (lighter, no rootlesskit).
//gpg: true: forward the host gpg-agent (bind ~/.gnupg + the live agent/keyboxd sockets) so commit signing works inside the sandbox using the host's key/token. Coexists with docker. Default false.
//gitBroker: true (default): git HTTPS/SSH access inside the sandbox is scoped to the repos actually related to the session (its own remotes + checked-out submodules, computed once at launch). `gh` is not disabled but rewired: gh invocations are relayed to the host broker, which executes a safelisted subset of subcommands for real (pr/issue/release/workflow/repo-view) against the same allow-list, and refuses everything else (gh api, gh auth, gh repo clone/fork/create, etc.) -- see README 'gh broker' for the exact list. No config needed for the common case -- this replaces the old approach of binding ~/.config/gh and ~/.ssh directly, which is no longer supported (those paths are never exposed, regardless of this flag or of `binds` below). Set false to turn off the broker/gate entirely (git still works, just unscoped via the forwarded ssh-agent; gh runs unwrapped but has no credentials since ~/.config/gh stays blocked). NOT a hard boundary when docker:true (the default): a container started via `docker run` inside the sandbox doesn't inherit the ssh/gh wrappers and can mount the forwarded ssh-agent socket directly, bypassing the scoping. See README 'Known limitations'.
//ssh: The SSH agent is auto-forwarded: ccserver finds the user's agent socket (preferring one with keys loaded) at launch and sets SSH_AUTH_SOCK. No config needed. Set env.SSH_AUTH_SOCK to override.
//binds: Extra host paths exposed inside the sandbox, on top of the project dir + ~/.claude + ~/.claude.json (and, with gpg:true, ~/.gnupg). mode: 'ro' (default) or 'rw'. Missing sources are skipped. ~ expands to your home. ~/.ssh and ~/.config/gh are always blocked here (see gitBroker above), so don't list them.
//env: Extra environment variables set inside the sandbox (applied last, so they override defaults). e.g. force a specific SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
//claudeBin: How to launch claude. Default: auto — resolve 'claude' on PATH and, if it's a wrapper to the real binary (e.g. /usr/bin/claude -> /opt/claude-code/bin/claude), expose that install dir in the sandbox automatically. Set this only if claude lives somewhere the auto-detect misses, or to pin a specific build. Absolute path recommended. Env var CCSERVER_CLAUDE_BIN overrides this.
